column3: NKJV has “Indeed,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “If.”
NKJV has “a little fire,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “how great a fire.”
NKJV has “our God and Father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord and Father.”
NKJV has “Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Neither can salt water yield fresh.”
